title: Solution for UCF UrbanTwin LUMPI Track: Sim-to-Real Urban LiDAR 3D Object Detection
abstract: arXiv:2609.07590v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present our solution to the LUMPI track of the UCF UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge at the 6th DriveX Workshop, ECCV 2026. The detector must be trained only on synthetic data and is evaluated on 50 held-out real LiDAR frames; a separate 50-frame synthetic submission is evaluated for point-cloud realism. Our method addresses the Sim2Real gap at three levels. First, we align synthetic scans to the 50k-point test density and build a 30k-record training pool using UT-LUMPI geometry, RangeLDM-based sampling diversification, rare-class copy-paste, and pedestrian-oriented augmentation. Second, complementary DSVT detectors and Car/Bus PointPillars specialists are trained under the same synthetic-only constraint. Third, predictions are integrated by class-aware routing, asymmetric agreement fusion, constrained residual-recall supplementation, class-coverage auditing, and selective box-size calibration. translated_title: UCF UrbanTwin LUMPI赛道解决方案：从仿真到真实的城市激光雷达三维目标检测
translated_abstract: 我们提出了在ECCV 2026第六届DriveX研讨会上举办的UCF UrbanTwin Sim2Real激光雷达挑战赛LUMPI赛道的解决方案。该检测器必须仅使用合成数据进行训练，并在50帧留出的真实激光雷达数据上进行评估；另外提交的50帧合成数据则用于评估点云真实感。我们的方法在三个层面解决仿真到真实（Sim2Real）的差距问题。首先，我们将合成扫描对齐到5万点的测试点云密度，并利用UT-LUMPI几何、基于RangeLDM的采样多样化、稀有类别复制粘贴以及面向行人的数据增强，构建了包含3万条记录的训练数据池。其次，在同样的仅限合成数据约束下，训练互补的DSVT检测器以及针对汽车/公交车的PointPillars专用检测器。第三，通过类别感知路由、非对称一致性融合、受约束的残差召回补充、类别覆盖审计和选择性边界框尺寸校准来整合预测结果。真实感分支则被独立优化。
tldr: 该论文提出一种仅使用合成数据训练的城市激光雷达三维目标检测方案，通过对齐点云密度并构建增强训练池、训练互补的多检测器、以及多级类别感知预测融合与校准三个层面策略，有效弥合了仿真到真实的领域差距。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a synthetic-only training solution for urban LiDAR 3D object detection that bridges the Sim2Real gap through three levels: density-aligned and augmented training data pools, complementary multi-detector ensembles, and class-aware prediction fusion with calibration.
